text:
maria: seeing a weird latency tail on canary today. bulk of spikes correlate with FP8 tiled kernel path + continuous batcher. any ideas?
aj: oh. which model / seq len? I noticed some padding blowups in sims yesterday.
maria: gpt-like ~8k, mix of short and long requests. profiler shows lots of tiny tiled kernels fired (~256x64 tiles) and KV cache churn. here's snippet:
```text
kernel=fp8_tiled tile=256x64 calls=8423 avg_ms=0.12 p95_ms=3.6
kvcache.evictions=312
batcher.pad_waste=18.7%
```
sam: is the continuous batcher grouping by tile shape? looks like tiling is creating many small batches which add scheduling overhead and increase pad waste.
aj: that rings a bell — we lowered the tiling threshold in PR#2345 to reduce large-kernel memory peaks. could be over-triggering for mixed seq workloads.
perf-bot: perf alert: tail-latency > SLA for 3 deploys in last hour. flamegraph: https://internal/perf/1965432100/flame
maria: confirmed regression window aligns with PR#2345. can we AB test disabling tiling for fp8 kernel path?
sam: quick mitigation: toggle env to disable tiling on canary and also bump kvcache eviction threshold to avoid churn. cheap and fast.
devops-bot: deploy triggered to canary with env BATCHER_TILE_DISABLE_FP8=true and kvcache.eviction_threshold=2048. canary id c-7789, rolling now.
aj: longer-term: add a fast-path kernel for very small tile sizes to avoid the per-kernel init spinlock and excessive kernel-launch overhead. I can prototype.
maria: +1. also add telemetry for tile shape distribution and per-tile kernel latency so we can correlate pad vs compute cost.
sam: I'll add batcher telemetry and heatmap for pad_waste per model and sequence-length bucket.
maria: Action items: @aj prototype fast-path kernel (target EOD), @sam add telemetry, I'll monitor canary and escalate/revert if no improvement. :eyes: 
aj: ack
sam: ack
perf-bot: canary metrics update: p95 tail-latency down ~23% after toggle. details: https://internal/perf/1965432100/canary
